description: Twelve original editable teaching diagrams, with matching PDF and vector SVG exports. No product UI, deployment or fresh default-notebook LLM claim.

DEF03.title: Building effective agents
DEF03.support: Attributed workflow/agent distinction, tools, feedback, stopping conditions. The live page notes that tooling has changed since 2024.

OT01.title: Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
OT01.support: OT responsibilities and controlled system boundaries; the exact pilot architecture is the tutorial author’s proposal.

EVAL01.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
EVAL01.support: Documentation, evaluation and accountable risk-management context; no NIST approval of this proposed pilot is claimed.

items.title: A script and an agent can use the same tools
items.caption: Under the attributed workflow/agent convention, code fixes a script’s next-step logic while an LLM can select an allowed next operation. Both can branch; branching alone does not establish agency.

items.title: Three checks before a study can be reviewed
items.caption: The review path requires the exact current case, every required limit and the full required model scope. An MV-only PASS cannot satisfy an MV/LV request.
